name: Reschedule an existing appointment
opening: Hi, I need to reschedule my Thursday afternoon shoulder follow-up. My name is Chris Nguyen.
facts: The existing visit is Thursday afternoon.
A morning appointment later next week is preferred.
The visit is a shoulder follow-up.
The patient can keep the original visit if no alternative exists.
goals: Find an acceptable alternative date and time.
Confirm the original visit is not canceled prematurely.
edge_cases: Ask the agent to preserve the original slot until a replacement is confirmed.
Correct any wrong body part or appointment date.
success_criteria: The agent avoids losing the existing appointment before confirming a new one.
The agent accurately confirms the replacement details.
The agent respects the morning preference or explains alternatives.
